description:
FILED s543u (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-28) by member 4 (the rule-12 read of the escape rewriter).

THE SHAPE (perl 5.40.3 vs the s543u tree):
    print "ab" =~ /(?<n>a)(?(<n>)b|c)/ ? "y[$&]" : "n", "\n";     # perl y[ab]
    print "ab" =~ /(?<n>a)(?('n')b|c)/ ? "y[$&]" : "n", "\n";     # perl y[ab]
    PCL: both die "Branch test must be look-ahead, look-behind or number" (trappable).

A fix: the rewrite scan knows the group numbers as it opens them (its NCAP counter, s543u); a name -> number table built there turns `(?(<name>)` into `(?(N)`.  Listed in docs/not-supported.md ns-regex-escapes.
frequency_reason: no Rosetta program, board dist, everyday program or lib/ shim holds `(?(<` or `(?('` (grepped s543u)
subject: LOUD: a NAMED condition `(?(<name>)yes|no)` / `(?('name')yes|no)` dies at the compile with cl-ppcre's "Branch test must be look-ahead, look-behind or number"; the numeric `(?(1)...)` works
triage_reason: perlre "Conditional expressions"; a one-pass rename to the group number is within the rewriter
